{{Quote|You should be able to walk into the Archives and monitor us without a problem.''"<br />"''Now that I am a Jedi, I can do that.|Cad Bane and Cato Parasitti, as the latter disguises herself as Ord Enisence|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
'''Cato Parasitti''' was a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]], Parasitti used her natural abilities to make a career as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], charging a massive rate and quickly becoming one of the leaders in her field of work. She employed [[holograph]]ic technology alongside her advanced shape-shifting skills to make her impersonations nearly flawless. A member of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] criminal underworld, Parasitti frequently worked with the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], often subcontracting assignments or hiring assistance for him as needed. On one such endeavor in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Parasitti worked with Bane to steal a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], as part of a job from the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. She adopted the guise of the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ord Enisence/Legends|Ord Enisence]] to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|infiltrate]] the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], acting as an inside [[Agent/Legends|agent]] to help Bane and his [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]], [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]], gain access to the heavily guarded [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vault]].

Posing as Enisence and then as [[Lore Keeper|Chief Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], Parasitti was able to neutralize the Temple's security systems so that Bane and Todo 360 could reach the Holocron Vault. When a Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], uncovered her deception, Parasitti attempted to escape, wielding Nu's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] against Tano. However, Parasitti lacked Nu's superior talents in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and she was defeated in the ensuing [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. Before being taken away for [[Prisoner/Legends|incarceration]], Parasitti offered the Jedi information on Bane's next target: [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], the keeper of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]]. By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], she was out of custody and, at one point, visited the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
===Hunter from Zolan===
{{Quote|And that's where your talents as a changeling will come in.|Cad Bane|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
[[File:CatoAndCad-HH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Parasitti worked closely with Cad Bane.]]
The [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Cato Parasitti lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule, hailing from [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]],<ref name="Databank" /> her [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] as a [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]], she used her natural proficiency in shape-shifting to make a career for herself out of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]]. Operating in the criminal underworld, she became known as one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] best [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and more lethal [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]],<ref name="Databank" /><ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> allowing her to charge a high rate, to the point that some considered it astronomical.<ref name="Databank" /> As was the case with other contemporaries in her field of work,<ref name="DB Cad Bane">{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}</ref> her only loyalty became her focus on [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. She often operated with another leading [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], for whom she would subcontract assignments or enlist extra assistance as needed.<ref name="Databank" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which the Republic fought with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] supremacy, Parasitti was considered to be one of the leaders in her line of work.<ref name="TCWCE" />

===The Jedi Temple job===
{{Quote|Who are you and what have you done with Madame Jocasta?''"<br />"''The same thing I'm going to do to you.|Ahsoka Tano confronting Cato Parasitti, posing as Jocasta Nu during her and Cad Bane's infiltration of the Jedi Temple|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
[[File:Skrilling_jedi_changeling.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Parasitti impersonates Ord Enisence to infiltrate the Jedi Archives.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="Holocron Heist Date">{{TCWdates|201}}</ref> Bane contacted Parasitti to enlist her services for a job on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> She proceeded to Bane's apartment in a seedy [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]],<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> being greeted at the door by Bane's [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]], [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]]. After setting down her [[Weequay blaster lance/Legends|blaster rifle]], Parasitti joined Bane at a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal to examine an intelligence file on [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who would be their next target once they had completed their first objective for their client, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. To Parasitti's surprise, she learned that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] had hired Bane to steal a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Although Sidious had provided [[holograph]]ic schematics of the Temple and data on its security systems, Bane's infiltration plan required an inside [[Agent/Legends|agent]]. Parasitti was to thus use her shape-shifting abilities to pose as a Jedi and infiltrate the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], from where she would be able to assist Bane and Todo 360 in entering the heavily guarded [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vault]]. Bane then showed her to the body of the [[Death/Legends|late]] Jedi Master [[Ord Enisence/Legends|Ord Enisence]],<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> whom he had killed in a previous job for Sidious<ref name="OEG:S1-2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> and whose identity she would assume to enter the Temple.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />
[[File:JocastaNu-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|210x210px|Jocasta Nu, the Chief Librarian.]]
Once Parasitti had adopted the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] Jedi's form, Bane handed her an [[Earbud comlink/Legends|ear-comlink]] that they would be using to keep in communication throughout the [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|operation]]. She proceeded to the Jedi Temple and, with Enisence's likeness, was able to gain access to the Jedi Archives. As she passed by the main rotunda on her way to<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> the Archive Library's Fourth Hall,<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Parasitti was intercepted by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been assigned to guard duty at the Archives and was looking for someone to help. When Parasitti was commed by Bane&mdash;who was with Todo 360 on the Temple exterior, waiting for her to get into place&mdash;she impatiently spurned Tano's repeated offers for assistance. Although her outburst caught the attention of [[Lore Keeper|Chief Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], Parasitti continued on to a computer and accessed the Temple security systems. She soon found a weak point in the Temple's [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shield]] and transmitted its location to Todo 360, then briefly jammed the local scanners so that Bane and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] could bypass the defensive shield and enter the central ventilation system. As Bane and Todo 360 descended into the main vent shaft, Parasitti guided Todo 360 to the control board for the series of fans blocking their way, but notified the pair&mdash;too late&mdash;of the secondary motion-sensing security switch. She was able to remotely deactivate the fans from her computer terminal just in time, saving Bane and Todo 360 from pulverization in the spinning blades.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

While continuing to direct Bane through the ventilation system, Parasitti was interrupted by Jocasta Nu, who was informing all Jedi in the Archives that the Temple was being placed on high alert. After thanking Nu for the notification, Parasitti attacked her and knocked her unconscious, dragging her [[Sleep/Legends|inert]] body into an aisle out of sight. Morphing to mirror Nu's appearance, Parasitti lifted her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from her person, then returned to her seat at her terminal. Presently, Bane informed Parasitti that they had reached the vent shaft above the Holocron Vault. She examined the security systems and managed to disable the grid of [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] protecting the Vault, granting Bane and Todo 360 access to the safe. Just as Parasitti detected that two Jedi were heading toward Bane's position in the vents, Tano&mdash;having learned from [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] about the potential presence of an enemy agent inside the Temple&mdash;overheard her conversation with Bane. When Tano confronted her, Parasitti activated Nu's lightsaber and initiated a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with the Padawan, lashing out with a flurry of strikes before heading to escape. However, she lacked Tano's [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and as Tano pursued her through the [[Holobook/Legends|holobook]] shelves of the Archive Library, she was consequently forced onto the defensive.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

[[File:DuelAtTheArchives-HH.jpg|thumb|250px|As Jocasta Nu, Parasitti attempts to hold out while dueling Ahsoka Tano.|left]]
Breaking off from engaging Tano, Parasitti headed out of the Fourth Hall, making her way back toward the rotunda. While glancing over her shoulder to check her pursuer's progress, Parasitti was outmaneuvered by the Padawan, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cut off her escape by [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] toppling a chair in her path. Held at [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber-point]], Parasitti surrendered and, upon being interrogated, revealed that Bane's objective laid in the Holocron Vault. Tano [[Binders/Legends|handcuffed]] Parasitti and escorted the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter to the Vault, being joined along the way by Nu, who had recovered consciousness. Bane, meanwhile, had made off with the holocron and escaped from the Temple, as Parasitti and her Jedi captors discovered upon seeing that the holocron was missing from the Vault.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

As Tano was about to lead her away, Parasitti stopped, deciding to point the Jedi to Bane's next target: Bolla Ropal. Master Ropal was the keeper of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|record]] of all known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|infants]] in the galaxy. While Tano left with her Master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to seek out Ropal in the [[Devaron system/Legends|Devaron system]], Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] saw to Parasitti's [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] and spearheaded the search for Bane on Coruscant.<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> Parasitti's disclosure of Bane's target earned her the ire of her colleague, who swore to return the favor when Skywalker and Tano [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|intercepted]] him at [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="Act on Instinct">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>

===Out of jail===
By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], two years after her detainment by the Jedi,<ref name="FF-2014 24: Maul's Legs">{{FactFile2014|24|MAU 1-2|Darth Maul's Cybernetic Legs}}</ref> Parasitti was out of custody. At one point while on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], she visited the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], sitting at a table with other patrons. She exchanged a laugh with several other customers after another guest, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], killed a [[Oked/Legends|bounty hunter]] who tried to talk her up; Ventress's response was to run one of her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|lightsabers]] through the bounty hunter's stomach, saying she was "not much of a talker."<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> Parasitti also patronized the cantina on another occasion, having a drink at the bar and being served by the [[Unidentified BU-series droid bartender/Legends|2-1B medical droid]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''I am Todo 360, techno-service droid. Who are you?''"<br />"''None of your business.''"<br />"''Everyone is in a good mood today.|Cato Parasitti is greeted by Todo 360 at Bane's apartment|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
[[File:CatoParasitti2-DB.jpg|thumb|230px|Cato Parasitti, lethal spy and assassin]]
In her native form, Cato Parasitti had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], standing at 1.79 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="TCWCE" /> and weighing 52 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="TCW H2H" /> An accomplished bounty hunter, she exploited her natural talents as a changeling to advance her career in the criminal underworld,<ref name="TCWCE" /> becoming known for her duplicity<ref name="Databank" /> and unscrupulousness.<ref name="Hasbro: Bane">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#22: Cad Bane|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW22_CadBane.asp}}</ref> A convincing liar, she often prepared to strike her targets by first spying on them to discern their weaknesses.<ref name="TCW H2H" /> She established herself as one of the galaxy's more lethal assassins, becoming attached to the financial reward of her missions and working for anyone who could afford her sizable rate, though her affiliation&mdash;aside from her sole loyalty to credits&mdash;was often only to herself. She subsequently became an associate of<ref name="Databank" /> another veteran mercenary, Cad Bane, who shared her penchant for credits. Although she knew of Bane's reputation for ruthlessness, she did not fear him like others did; being a shape-shifter, she could easily disappear into the crowd when needed.<ref name="TCWCE" />

Parasitti kept a tight hold on her identity, telling those who inquired after her name that it was none of their business. Despite initially believing, like Bane, that breaking into the Jedi Temple was impossible,<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> she could not pass up the opportunity to disguise herself as a Jedi Master, being able to walk undetected among the Jedi.<ref name="TCWCE" /><ref name="TCW New Battlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> While on the job, she kept a cool head under pressure, managing to deactivate the fans in the ventilation shaft before they could kill Bane and Todo 360. She did not back down when confronting a Jedi, Ahsoka Tano, though the Padawan ultimately defeated her. After Bane escaped on his own,<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> Parasitti, furious with being left behind in Jedi custody,<ref name="Visual Guide Updated">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> tipped off the Jedi to his next target,<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> a decision that earned her a promise for payback from her comrade.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|You may have Madame Jocasta's shape, but not her skills.|Ahsoka Tano|audio=NotHerSkills-HH.flac|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
[[File:ParasittiAsJocasta-HH.jpg|thumb|250px|Parasitti's natural skills as a shape-shifter were considerably advanced.|left]]
Cato Parasitti's abilities as a shape-shifter were quite advanced:<ref name="Databank" /> she was able to morph her likeness into that of another individual after physical contact,<ref name="Holocron Heist Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250596241505e20124163b4c820005|text=Dataclip: Holocron Heist|na=video file}}</ref> though her shape-shifting was limited to other [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] forms.<ref name="TCW H2H" /> Besides imitating [[Human/Legends|Humans]] such as Jocasta Nu, Parasitti succeeded in altering her form to that of a Skrilling, Ord Enisence. In the latter case, she was able to avoid being uncovered by his fellow Jedi, with an outburst of impatience being the only potential error to her mimicry.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

Besides infiltration,<ref name="TCWCE" /> Parasitti was skilled in fighting, using acrobatic somersaults to supplement her efforts against Ahsoka Tano. Yet she lacked lightsaber training and was thus at a disadvantage when dueling Tano.<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> During their fight, Parasitti mainly concentrated on defensive moves, with her attacks coming across as untrained and overdone.<ref name="Holocron Heist Commentary">{{SW|url=video/holocron-heist-episode-featurette|text="Holocron Heist" Episode Featurette}}</ref> She was subsequently defeated by the Padawan.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

==Equipment==
Cato Parasitti customarily wore a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] with [[Night vision/Legends|night vision]] lenses that only partially covered her head,<ref name="TCWCE" /> often wearing it even when not on the job.<ref name="Holocron Heist" /><ref name="Revenge" /> She used a set of armor for her chest, [[Limb/Legends|arms]], and shins that she scavenged from a captured fugitive, while she also employed extra thigh padding for [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop riding]]. A pair of utility pouches held various equipment above her waist.<ref name="TCWCE" /><ref name="TCW New Battlefronts" /> Parasitti utilized holographic technology to supplement her shape-shifting, allowing her to imitate clothing such as [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] in addition to her bodily alterations.<ref name="Databank" /> For weaponry, she wielded an [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistol]]<ref name="TCW New Battlefronts" /> and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] of an ancient model<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> that was commonly used in the underworld.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was very important that Cato Parasitti as Jocasta Nu does not really have lightsaber skills. So we actually went through a large amount of effort to make most of the impostor's attacks defensive, and when offensive, incredibly wild and overdone.|Dave Filoni|<ref name="Holocron Heist Comment">{{SWArchive|url=watch/holocronheist_commentary.html|text=Episode Commentary #2.1 &ndash; Holocron Heist}}</ref>}}
[[File:CatoParasittiMask-DB.png|thumb|180px|Design for Parasitti's mask]]
The character of Cato Parasitti was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Prior to her debut in "[[Holocron Heist]]," which aired on [[October 3]], [[2009]] as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] premiere,<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide" /> series modeler [[Chris Bostjanick]]'s model of her was previewed in the [[July]] 2009 compilation, ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> In the episode, Parasitti was voiced by actress [[Gwendoline Yeo]].<ref name="Holocron Heist Ep Guide" /> According to Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]], the production crew made it a point during the duel sequence to make Parasitti's lightsaber moves primarily defensive or otherwise rather crude, to reflect the fact that she lacked training with the weapon.<ref name="Holocron Heist Commentary" /> Other materials to mention her included entries in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]]<ref name="Databank" /> and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'']].<ref name="TCWCE" />

In [[March]] [[2011]], Parasitti was featured as a character in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] editions of the non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. Following the "[[Legacy of Terror]]" level, she is made available for in-game purchase for use in the game's "Free Play" mode.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III DS">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition}}</ref> She later made brief appearances in the episodes "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" and "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]," which aired in March [[2012]] as part of the finale story arc for the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]].<ref name="Explore: Bounty">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bounty-episode-guide|text="Bounty" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref><ref name="Explore: Revenge">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/revenge-episode-guide|text="Revenge" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Although the episodes showed her to be free from Jedi custody, it was not clarified how she came to be free.<ref name="Bounty" /><ref name="Revenge" /> [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]] implied she had escaped, stating that she managed to "find her way out of custody" after "Holocron Heist" to appear in those episodes.<ref name="Chronicling TCW 7">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-7|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #7|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref>

''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head]]'' lists Parasitti's height as 1.8 meters,<ref name="TCW H2H" /> which is slightly off from the 1.79-meter height detailed in prior publications; the original figure was established in her StarWars.com Databank entry and repeated in ''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia''.<ref name="Databank" /><ref name="TCWCE" /> This article assumes that ''The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head'' is in error.

===Non-canon history===
''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Head-to-Head'' presents a non-canon matchup showdown between Parasitti and [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]] of the planet [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia's]] [[Talz village/Legends|village]] of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]]. Parasitti is hired by corporate [[Baron/Legends|barons]] to eliminate Thi-Sen, whose Talz colony is thwarting their [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] efforts to find valuable resources amidst the planet's glaciers. Parasitti first spends some time posing as one of the Talz, observing Thi-Sen and his culture. When the time comes to confront him, she exploits Thi-Sen's limited exposure to technology and [[Alien/Legends|alien]] lifeforms by shape-shifting into a young Talz, confusing him. She then takes on the form of a demon from Talz mythology, distracting Thi-Sen long enough to blast him and thus completing her assignment.<ref name="TCW H2H" />
